items.name: Basic scatter plot
items.description: A scatter plot displays individual data points as symbols. It is typically showing relationships or patterns between two data attributes that are mapped to the X- and the Y-position.

items.name: Color scale
items.description: A scale maps the value of a data attribute to a visual property of the mark, in this case the X- and the Y-positions and the fill color.

items.name: Shape scale
items.description: A scale maps the value of a data attribute to a visual property of the mark, in this case the X and Y position, the fill color and the shape.

items.name: Data labels
items.description: Data labels are annotations that provide additional information about individual data points.

items.name: Basic bubble plot
items.description: A bubble plot is a scatter plot with an additional dimension. The size of the circle marks are scaled, based on a numeric data attribute.

items.name: Custom bubble plot
items.description: Each part of a default plot can be customized using specialized nodes, which provide access to detailed parameters of the plot components and the plot style.

items.name: Basic connected scatter
items.description: A connected scatter plot is a scatter plot where data points are connected by a line. It is often used to show the variation of a data attribute over time or as a sequence.

items.name: Grouped connected scatter
items.description: A grouped connected scatter plot is a scatter plot where groups of data points are connected by lines. It is used to compare trends or relationships between groups.

items.name: Basic line plot
items.description: A line plot displays a line connecting data points. It is often used to show the variation of a data attribute over time or as a sequence.

items.name: Grouped line plot
items.description: A grouped line plot displays a separate line for each group of data points. It is used to compare trends or relationships between groups.

items.name: Basic area plot
items.description: An area plot displays an area outlined by connected data points. It is often used to show evolutions or cumulative data over time.

items.name: Stacked area plot
items.description: A stacked area plot displays a separate area for each group of data points. The areas are stacked on top of each other.

items.name: Basic bar plot
items.description: A bar plot represents categorical data on one axis with rectangular bars. The length of each bar is proportional to the numeric data on the other axis.

items.name: Basic lollipop plot
items.description: A lollipop plot displays data points as symbols (like a scatter plot), and connects them to a baseline by vertical or horizontal segments. Lollipop plots are often used as a visually cleaner alternative to bar plots.

items.name: Basic waffle plot
items.description: A waffle plot displays categorical data as colored rectangles on a grid. Each grid unit represents a proportional ratio of the total data count. A waffle plot is often used to visualize proportions or percentages.

items.name: Heatmap
items.description: A heatmap displays data values as colors in a matrix. It provides an intuitive way to visualize patterns, correlations, or density across two dimensions.
